service.en: Issue vehicle export certificate outside UAE
service.ar: إصدار شهادة تصدير مركبة خارج الدولة
service.ur: متحدہ عرب امارات سے باہر گاڑی برآمد کرنے کا سرٹیفکیٹ
service.ml: യുഎഇക്ക് പുറത്തേക്ക് വാഹനം കയറ്റുമതി ചെയ്യാനുള്ള സർട്ടിഫിക്കറ്റ്

about: Get a certificate to export a vehicle out of the UAE.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

fees: 50 AED for a light vehicle, a vehicle over 3 and under 12 tonnes, light machinery, a motorcycle, or a bus of 14 to 26 or more than 26 passengers
100 AED for a 12-tonne vehicle or heavy machinery
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS)
an Integrated Transport Center service centre
